hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.java|*.jj|*.jjt) [ -f "$f" ] && ! grep -q 'Licensed under the Apache License' "$f" && jq -n --arg f "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:($f + " has no Apache license header - run `mvn license:format` before finishing.")}}';; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
